LanguageData.AA_FrostboundBehemoth.description: Крупные членистоногие, приспособленные к экстремально низким температурам.
LanguageData.AA_LuciferBug.description: Small insectoids, genetically modified to produce small batches of Luciferium extract every few days.
LanguageData.AA_NightMule.description: A hardy pack beasts, used for transporting loads or doing other heavy work, they originate from a RimWorld orbiting a very faint star and thus they have adapted to environments with low sunlight.
LanguageData.VRE_Beetle.description: Hardy arthropods prized for their resilience and diverse adaptations, selectively bred into livestock suited to a variety of environments and purposes.
LanguageData.VRE_Beetle.label: жук
LanguageData.VRE_Myrmidon.description: Ant-derived creatures bred into diverse forms of livestock, retaining aspects of their ancestral biology beneath their oversized forms.
LanguageData.VRE_Myrmidon.label: мирмидон
